sourcePolicy: The PMVBRY guideline, official EPFO portal and Ministry of Labour/PIB releases are the primary sources. Part A and Part B remain separate records because they have different beneficiaries, conditions, payment rails and calculations. UdyamVeda prepares and explains evidence but does not create UANs, handle OTPs or file EPFO records.

records.sourceAnchor: Part A first-time employee eligibility, EPFO/ECR continuity, UAN face authentication, two instalments, financial literacy and employee DBT
observations: The official guideline defines a registration period from 1 August 2025 to 31 July 2027 and states that employees joining during that period are considered for threshold, additionality and incentive calculations.

Part A is for a qualifying first-time employee, not the employer. The record must verify no prior contributing EPFO or eligible exempted-trust membership, joining date, gross wage at joining, establishment coverage, ECR contributions and UAN face authentication through UMANG.

The guideline structures the benefit as one completed month of EPF wage up to Rs 15,000 in two instalments, with the second instalment depending on the prescribed twelve-month ECR and financial-literacy conditions. The amount must not be shown without those conditions.

The Ministry release states that Part A payments use Aadhaar Bridge Payment System DBT. Bank seeding, identity authentication, payment status and any operational portal instructions remain sensitive workflow details requiring current verification.

Re-joiners or employees with prior contributory EPFO membership must not be silently treated as first timers. Unknown employment history must return more information required, not automatic ineligibility.
UdyamVeda may prepare an evidence checklist and official handoff, but must not create/authenticate a UAN, handle OTPs, submit an employee claim or represent itself as EPFO.
reviewFollowUps: Verify current PMVBRY portal operation, employee/establishment forms, identity/authentication steps, payment status and grievance route.
Confirm first-time status against prior EPFO or eligible exempted-trust membership, joining date and gross wage at joining.
Reconcile ECR contribution receipt, six-month and twelve-month conditions, seasonal-establishment treatment and financial-literacy completion.
Verify Aadhaar Bridge Payment System, Aadhaar-seeded bank-account conditions, suspended-payment handling and privacy/security boundaries.
Check amendments, implementation circulars and any changes to the registration period or operational calculation rules.
Obtain a human reviewer decision; keep the employee record separate from Part B and review-gated before publication.

records.sourceAnchor: Part B employer baseline/additionality, wage slabs, ECR continuity, rolling averages, manufacturing extension and PAN-linked payment
observations: Part B is an employer/establishment incentive, not an employee benefit. The benefit calculation must remain separate from Part A and must use the establishment's prescribed baseline and rolling additional-employment tests.

The guideline requires EPFO coverage or eligible exempted-establishment status, regular ECR contributions, qualifying employment during the registration period, wage limits, six-month continuity and the applicable additional-employment threshold.

The draft benefit slabs are up to Rs 1,000, Rs 2,000 or Rs 3,000 per additional employment per month based on the prescribed EPF-wage bands, normally for two years and potentially four years for manufacturing. Headline slabs are not guaranteed value because baseline, rolling-average, ECR and other conditions control payment.

The Ministry release states that Part B payments go directly to the employer's PAN-linked account. Establishment onboarding, PAN/GSTN, bank, ECR, inquiry/fraud and grievance conditions require current portal verification.

The scheme outlay is a programme limit and cannot be divided across employees as a guaranteed business value. Months that fail the applicable threshold or contain disqualifying irregularities must not be ranked as certain benefits.
UdyamVeda can prepare an ECR/workforce-baseline checklist, but must not file ECRs, access EPFO credentials, handle OTPs or claim to be an EPFO filing agent.
reviewFollowUps: Verify current employer registration, establishment-code, PAN/GSTN, PAN-linked-bank and portal workflow requirements.
Recalculate the prescribed baseline and additional-employment threshold for the particular establishment, including the new-establishment baseline rule.
Verify rolling-average tests, ECR contribution receipt, six-month continuity, wage slabs, re-joiner treatment and employment dates.
Confirm manufacturing classification and the third/fourth-year extension conditions; do not assume every MSME receives four years.
Check pending EPFO inquiries, fraud FIR/irregularity exclusions, payment timing, amendments, detailed calculation SOPs and grievance routes.
Obtain a human reviewer decision; keep Part B separate from the employee record and review-gated before publication.
